summary: WINEK iteration 22 - Edit Service feature fully tested. Backend: 9/9 tests pass (PUT /api/services/{id}: scalar-only update, full location+slot replacement, owner check). Frontend: stepper navigation, pre-fill, owner buttons all pass. Fixed critical 422 bug in edit-service/[id].tsx (tag_ids sent as string instead of array). One UX issue reported: Alert.alert doesn't render on web after save.

minor.issue: tag_ids returned as JSON string '"[]"' instead of array []. Root cause: create_service and update_service use json.dumps(data.tag_ids) before passing to asyncpg, which double-encodes via JSONB codec (json.dumps(json.dumps([])) = '"[]"'). Also _enrich_service parses raw_tags but doesn't normalize svc['tag_ids'] back to a list.

bug_fixed.issue: loadService() set selectedTags = data.tag_ids where data.tag_ids was '"[]"' (a string due to backend double-encoding). handleSubmit then sent tag_ids: '"[]"' in PUT body, causing 422 Pydantic validation error ('Input should be a valid list').
bug_fixed.fix: Added defensive parsing: if tag_ids is a string, JSON.parse it; if array use as-is; otherwise default to []. Line 101 in edit-service/[id].tsx

action_items: HIGH: Fix Alert.alert after save in edit-service/[id].tsx for web compatibility. Replace Alert.alert with: (1) Platform.OS === 'web' ? router.replace('/service/{id}') : Alert.alert(...), OR (2) use a toast notification, OR (3) call router.replace directly after successful PUT without waiting for user confirmation

MEDIUM: Fix backend double-encoding of tag_ids in service_routes.py: In create_service (line 163), change json.dumps(data.tag_ids) → data.tag_ids. In update_service (line 207), change json.dumps(raw['tag_ids']) → raw['tag_ids']. Also normalize svc['tag_ids'] in _enrich_service to always return a list (add: svc['tag_ids'] = raw_tags or [])
LOW: Other services created via the stepper (svc_demo001, etc.) may also have corrupted tag_ids stored as double-encoded strings. A DB migration to fix these may be needed after backend fix.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL RCA: service_routes.py create_service uses json.dumps(data.tag_ids) before passing to asyncpg. The _init_connection JSONB codec also calls json.dumps on write, causing double-encoding. Result: tag_ids stored as JSON string '"[]"' instead of JSON array []. Fix: remove manual json.dumps calls and let asyncpg codec handle JSONB serialization.

MEDIUM: edit-service/[id].tsx handleSubmit uses Alert.alert which is not web-compatible for navigation. After PUT success, the user has no feedback and stays on the edit page. This breaks the complete UX flow on web.

LOW: In service_routes.py update_service, SCALAR_FIELDS doesn't include 'price' correctly when price=0 (not a real issue since price must be >0, but worth noting for robustness). Actually it IS included: raw.get(k) is not None check - 0 is not None so it works. No issue.

rca_of_issue.bug: 422 Unprocessable Entity on PUT /api/services/{id} from edit-service UI
rca_of_issue.root_cause: 1. Backend stores tag_ids as double-encoded JSON string ('"[]"') due to json.dumps() call before asyncpg JSONB codec. 2. Frontend loadService() set selectedTags = '"[]"' (string). 3. handleSubmit sent tag_ids: '"[]"' (string) in PUT body. 4. Pydantic ServiceUpdate.tag_ids = Optional[List[str]] rejected the string with 'list_type' validation error.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: 1. Login as coach. 2. Go to /edit-service/svc_4842a8361c1f. 3. Navigate to step 5. 4. Click 'Sauvegarder les modifications'. 5. Network tab shows PUT returns 422 with detail: [{'type':'list_type','loc':['body','tag_ids'],'msg':'Input should be a valid list','input':'[]'}]
rca_of_issue.fix_applied: Frontend defensive fix in edit-service/[id].tsx line 101: Array.isArray check with JSON.parse fallback for string tag_ids
rca_of_issue.backend_fix_needed: Remove json.dumps() in service_routes.py create_service and update_service for tag_ids field. Also normalize svc['tag_ids'] in _enrich_service.
